author: Sam Rabadi
title: Athlete of the Week: Mason Lopez - NewsBreak
text:
By Sam Rabadi ,
30 minutes ago
PHARR, Texas ( ValleyCentral ) — PSJA North basketball has its most wins in five years and is on the cusp of ending a four-year playoff drought. It’s been a total team buy-in including top scorer Mason Lopez.
“Just hard work and dedication,” Mason Lopez, PSJA North Senior Guard, said. “Coming here in the gym, late hours, putting up shots, and getting better every day.”
The Raiders play in arguably the toughest district in the valley – District 31-5A, which includes the likes of unbeaten McAllen High, Vela, and both Sharyland schools. Despite the tough district, the Raiders find themselves in second place.
“Not to be satisfied,” Lopez said. “We want more right now, and we’re clicking at the right time. We’re playing good basketball at the right time, so we just got to keep that going, keep that up.”
In Romeo De La Garza’s first year coaching Mason, he has been blown away by both the human and the 20-point scorer on the floor.
“He’s a great teammate,” Romeo De La Garza, PSJA North boys’ head basketball coach, said. “He’s an outstanding student athlete. He comes in every day ready to work. He comes in every day to want him to improve. He’s just a respectful young man, and he’s got a bright future.”
Mason has never made the playoffs, and the senior would like to end his high school career with that taste of the postseason.
“Been a long journey, though, for me to get here, and it’s just been a crazy journey, but I’ve just kept my head down and working hard has gotten me to a good point,” Lopez said.
Having become the quiet leader on a hopeful squad, what would Mason tell his younger self just entering his high school playing career?
“Just keep going, man,” Lopez said. “Don’t give up, life’s tough. It’s going to hit you with adversity, but it’s my job to keep going through adversity and never give up.”
More than just a hooper, Mason Lopez already has his Associate’s Degree in marketing, the strategy for his opponents – stop Mason at all costs.
